themes.description: Users are complaining about high brokerage charges, hidden fees, and lack of transparency in charges. They feel that the app is overcharging them, making it difficult to make profits. Some users even feel cheated due to the high charges.
themes.business_impact: High brokerage charges and lack of transparency in fees are leading to customer dissatisfaction, high churn risk, and potential revenue loss.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app's pricing strategy and fee structure may be flawed, leading to overcharging and lack of transparency.
themes.action_plan:
• Review and revise the pricing strategy to ensure competitiveness, introduce transparent fee structures, and educate customers about charges.
• Develop a tool to clearly display all applicable fees and charges.
• Establish a feedback mechanism for customers to report any suspicious charges.

themes.description: Groww app's users experienced issues with transaction discrepancies, withdrawals pending for a long time, and incorrect balances, causing financial loss and frustration.
themes.business_impact: Groww suffered from loss of user trust and reputation damage due to unfulfilled transactions, delayed withdrawals, and incorrect balances.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Groww's technical issues and lack of transparent communication may be causing these problems, which could be due to over-reliance on automated systems or inadequate testing.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct thorough testing to identify and fix the root causes of transaction discrepancies and withdrawal issues
• Improve communication channels with users to provide clear updates on transaction status
• Develop a more robust system to handle failed transactions and provide better support for users experiencing technical issues.
